About

About Farside.

Farside lets you use your own Mac from your iPhone or iPad. Your Mac’s screen shows on your phone, and the whole phone screen becomes its trackpad.

What it is

Farside has two parts. Farside for Mac runs on your Mac and is free. Farside for iPhone and iPad is the app you hold.

On the same Wi‑Fi it’s free, with no account and no ads. The Anywhere plan lets you reach your Mac from somewhere else: CA$7.99 a month or CA$59.99 a year, after a 7-day free trial.

Who makes it

Farside is made by Roshan Silva Pulle, an independent developer in Canada.

Farside at getfarside.com isn’t related to farside.app or to other products with a similar name.

Where it stands

Farside is in beta and coming soon to the App Store. Join the beta and we’ll email you an invite.

Contact

Email support@getfarside.com. We reply within two business days. The support page has setup help and answers.
